title: Shortest Path with One-Time Edge Reversal per Node
description:
You are given a directed weighted graph consisting of n nodes numbered from 0 to n - 1. The graph is represented by an array edges, where each element edges[i] = [u, v, w] denotes a directed edge from node u to node v with a cost of w.

Each node has a special ability (a switch) that can be used at most once. When you reach a node u, if you have not used its switch yet, you may choose to:

Pick any incoming edge v → u
Temporarily reverse it to u → v
Immediately traverse this reversed edge

Traversing a reversed edge costs twice the original weight, i.e., 2 × w.

Note:

The reversal is valid only for that single traversal.
Each node’s switch can be used only once during the entire journey.

Your task is to compute the minimum cost required to travel from node 0 to node n - 1.
If it is impossible to reach the destination, return -1.
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
